description: This file defines the DeviceStatusService class which provides device status information such as battery, thermal, storage, network status, and device info in an iOS application. It implements the DeviceStatusServicing protocol and interacts with system frameworks to gather device metrics.

classes.name: DeviceStatusService
classes.description: A service class for fetching device status information such as battery, thermal, storage, network, and device info on iOS devices.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves consolidated device status information, including battery, thermal, storage, network status, and uptime.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns device-specific information such as device name, model, OS version, app version, build, and locale.

methods.name: batteryStatus
methods.description: Provides the current battery level and state, along with low power mode status.

methods.name: thermalStatus
methods.description: Provides the current thermal state of the device.

methods.name: storageStatus
methods.description: Provides storage information including total, free, and used bytes.

methods.name: fallbackAppBuild
methods.description: Returns a fallback build number if the provided build string is empty.
